BIOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Support in Plants.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support in Plants.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support in Plants.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support in Plants.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement in Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement in Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement in Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement in Animals.

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Plants.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Plants.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Plants.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Plants.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Genetics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Genetics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Genetics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Genetics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Genetics.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Animals.

17. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.

19. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

20. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash
